label: v4 · flow · partial
out_unit: share of the neuron's output, T_ij = W_ij / d_j
note: The flow engine has no spikes: it computes the walk's distribution pi exactly (Eq. 1). Dots are 32 walkers sampled from that chain (restart at the stimulus with probability 0.2, else a step along T); a walk step is one walker's hop, an exact sample. The action is drawn from the exact pi, not from the walkers.
